items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: he had an alto player called Louie Warnecke and he was the first one I ever heard do that slap tongue business.

ctx.x: But, you know, when I got the sax then I learned how to what they call "slap tongue." You see, in Piron's big band
he had an alto player called Louie Warnecke and he was the first one I ever heard do that slap tongue business.
